people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Nebo_Mount
people.line: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land

people.name: Pisgah
people.line: A mountain range in Moab, east of the Jordan

translations.web: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
translations.bsb: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land—from Gilead as far as Dan,
translations.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
translations.asv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And Jehovah showed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
